name: Apprenticeship — Break In Learning + Withdrawal (7 days)
description: Creates a 2-year apprenticeship (2025-08-01 to 2027-07-31), then PUTs an update with a 3-month break in learning (pause 2026-07-31, resume 2026-11-01). The post-break expected end date is 2027-10-31 (original end 2027-07-31 pushed back by the 92-day break). Learner is withdrawn 7 days after resuming (2026-11-08).
